findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dynamic attribute access injection
 * @description Dynamic attribute access via getattr or similar could lead to attribute injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/dynamic-attribute-access
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-470
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("getattr").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("setattr").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("delattr").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("hasattr").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("compile").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("__import__").getACall()
select call, "Dynamic attribute access or code execution function that could be vulnerable to injection."
findings.hypothesis: Dynamic attribute access or code execution functions that could be vulnerable to injection

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dynamic code execution patterns
 * @description Various dynamic code execution patterns that could be vulnerable to injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/dynamic-code-execution
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Dynamic imports
  call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("importlib.import_module").getACall() or
  // Namespace access
  call = API::builtin("globals").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("locals").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("vars").getACall() or
  // Code compilation
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
  // Dynamic attribute access (already checked but include for completeness)
  call = API::builtin("getattr").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("setattr").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("hasattr").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("delattr").getACall()
select call, "Dynamic code execution or attribute access pattern that could be vulnerable to injection."
findings.hypothesis: Dynamic code execution patterns that could be vulnerable to injection if user input influences them
